access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# Fetch all playlists in library (paginated)
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlists_page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
print('playlist_ids_sample', [p['playlist_id'] for p in all_playlists[:10]])

# Gather unique song ids across all playlists
all_song_ids = set()
for p in all_playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        all_song_ids.add(sid)
print('unique_song_ids_in_all_playlists', len(all_song_ids))
print('unique_song_ids_sample', sorted(all_song_ids)[:20])

access_token = spotify_login['access_token']

# Determine reggae songs and collect their artists
reggae_song_ids = set()
reggae_artist_ids = set()

song_id_list = sorted(all_song_ids)
print('checking_song_count', len(song_id_list))

for idx, sid in enumerate(song_id_list):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = s.get('genre')
    if isinstance(genre, str) and genre.lower() == 'reggae':
        reggae_song_ids.add(sid)
        for a in s.get('artists', []):
            if 'id' in a:
                reggae_artist_ids.add(a['id'])
    # Print a small sample of matches
    if sid in reggae_song_ids and len(reggae_song_ids) <= 5:
        print('match_song', sid, 'title', s.get('title'), 'genre', genre, 'artists', [a.get('name') for a in s.get('artists', [])])

print('reggae_song_count', len(reggae_song_ids))
print('reggae_artist_count', len(reggae_artist_ids))
print('reggae_artist_ids', sorted(reggae_artist_ids))
